title: General profile kernel for paired preference assignments
hypotheses_covered: xPref has balanced marginals: sum of sign encodings over the 6 orderings is 0
yPref has balanced marginals: sum of sign encodings over the 6 orderings is 0
signed cross-correlation of xPref and yPref equals -2
S and T are arbitrary finite subsets of [n]
n is the (arbitrary) number of voters / dimension
replaced:
Let $\mathrm{xPref},\mathrm{yPref}:\mathrm{Fin}\,6\to\mathrm{Bool}$ be two
preference assignments with balanced marginals
$\sum_k s(\mathrm{xPref}(k)) = \sum_k s(\mathrm{yPref}(k)) = 0$ and cross-sum
$\sum_k s(\mathrm{xPref}(k))\,s(\mathrm{yPref}(k)) = -2$.  Then for all
$S,T\subseteq[n]$,
\[
  \Bigl(\tfrac16\Bigr)^{\!n}\sum_{p:\mathrm{Profile}\,n}
    \chi_S\bigl(\mathrm{xPref}\circ p\bigr)\,\chi_T\bigl(\mathrm{yPref}\circ p\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \begin{cases} (-1/3)^{|S|} & S = T \\ 0 & S\ne T. \end{cases}
\]
